description: A real supplier's mailbox was compromised; the attacker replied inside an existing invoice thread with a link to a fake login page. The sender domain itself has a clean reputation. Credential harvesting was observed and one user entered a password. Analyst view: true positive; contain.

alert.rule: Credential submission to unknown login page

mail_scope.subject: RE: Invoice 4471 - updated bank details
mail_scope.body: Please see the updated invoice in the shared folder and confirm by end of day.
